title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 062 ]

blocks.text: No one has to let errors of the past destroy his present or cloud his future. The glorious fact is that we can always have a new beginning. Naturally, a wise person will try to avoid feelings of guilt by avoiding the acts that cause them. He will look and exercise his moral judgment before he leaps. But if he does something wrong, he must accept his errors frankly, make an effort to obtain forgiveness, and make compensation if that is possible. Then he can go his way with an untroubled mind.

readingSentences.english: No one has to let errors of the past destroy his present or cloud his future.
readingSentences.korean: 누구도 과거의 실수가 자신의 현재를 파괴하거나 미래에 먹구름을 끼게 해서는 안된다.

readingSentences.english: The glorious fact is that we can always have a new beginning.
readingSentences.korean: 다행인 것은 항상 새로운 시작을 할 수 있다는 거다.

readingSentences.english: Naturally, a wise person will try to avoid feelings of guilt by avoiding the acts that cause them.
readingSentences.korean: 당연히 현명한 사람은 죄의식을 야기시키는 행동을 피함으로써 죄의식을 피하려 할 것이다.

readingSentences.english: He will look and exercise his moral judgment before he leaps.
readingSentences.korean: 그는 뛰기 전에 살피고 도덕적 판단력을 행할 것이다.

readingSentences.english: But if he does something wrong, he must accept his errors frankly, make an effort to obtain forgiveness, and make compensation if that is possible.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 만약 그가 정말 잘못을 하면, 그는 당연히 자신의 과오를 솔직히 받아들이고 용서를 구하려고 노력하며, 가능하다면 보상을 하려 한다.

readingSentences.english: Then he can go his way with an untroubled mind.
readingSentences.korean: 그러면 말끔한 마음으로 길을 갈 수 있다.
